title: Google’s AI search changes upended online publishing

llm_summary: Google’s recent overhaul of its AI‑driven search results has thrown a wrench into the digital publishing model that long depended on predictable traffic from Google’s organic listings. By reshuffling rankings, favoring its own AI‑generated snippets, and reducing visibility for many news sites, the changes threaten ad revenue and audience reach for publishers, prompting a scramble to adapt to the new search landscape.
